definition: the gap left by nine months of uncategorised spending

settled:
The categorising is manual, Jen has owned it alone, and she is nine months behind.

We always know the total, because the total is just balances. What we do not have is budget balances.

So the gap does not blind us to how much there is or how fast it is going.

What it costs is the breakdown. Which line a given spend went to, and so whether that spend was capacity or consumption.

title: What Our Budget Cannot Tell Us
